supported_claim: A 16-word binary length-11 code has covering radius 3, verified by two direct enumeration paths and a syndrome-space cross-check. For hypothetical 15-word covers, exact certificates prove minimum distance at most 5, total pair-ball overlap at least 1712, and total triple-ball overlap at least 280. A complete 150-branch normalized cover has 112 certified closures and 38 residual branches. Within four selected hard third-word children, checked RUP certificates close 184 of 350 exhaustive fourth-word branches, leaving 166 branches and all four children open.

construction.blocker: No verified 15-word covering code exists in the repository.

lower_bound.blocker: Thirty-eight normalized residual branches remain without a checked exclusion.

baseline.scope: Direct and syndrome-space verification of a 16-word linear radius-3 cover.

exact_search.scope: Audited formulas, complete canonical partitions, exact structural bounds, checked DRAT traces, and a machine-verified residual ledger.

partial_proof_frontier.scope: 112 of 150 normalized branches closed, with 38 residual branches listed and hashed.

fourth_word_rup_bundle.scope: 184 of 350 exhaustive fourth-word branches closed within four selected hard third-word children; 166 branches remain and no complete child or normalized parent is closed.
